description:
Tails and ships log files

Filebeat is an open source file harvester, mostly used to fetch logs files and feed them into logstash. Together with the libbeat lumberjack output is a replacement for logstash-forwarder.
## Features and enhancements
- Build the input status report of Beat receivers in time linear in the number of inputs. #53723

## Fixes
- Fix quadratic cost of building the receiver config for units with many streams. #53726 #53731
- Update Brotli to 1.2.7 to fix a decoder panic on malformed input. #54234
- Reduce retries and repeated error logs from Beat receivers while the output is unreachable. #54271
- Fix "ApiVersionsRequest V3" errors on Kafka broker connections by updating the Sarama fork. #54546
- Limit request bodies buffered by the http_endpoint input for HMAC validation to 25 MiB when max_body_bytes is not set. #53937
- Fix the aws-s3 input rejecting non_aws_bucket_name configurations that set only default_region. #54143
- Fix duplicate event IDs for codec-decoded objects in the gcs and azure-blob-storage inputs. #54157 #53659
- Fix processors being applied twice to Elastic Agent filestream inputs configured without streams. #54416
- Update mito to v1.27.1 to fix failures when following redirects with a response body, and to stop the CEL lazy stream decoders from losing read or decoding errors. #54430
- Align redirect header handling in Okta and Jamf entity analytics with httpjson and CEL. #54493
- Fix the entity analytics input committing sync state before all events are acknowledged. #54494 #54432
- Report entity analytics minimal-state input health and retry failed full syncs sooner. #54496 #54436
- Write Azure Event Hub v2 checkpoints once per message, after all of its records are processed. #54503
- Fix the azure-blob-storage and gcs inputs re-reading files on every poll when file names have mixed case. #54512
- Apply HTTP and tracer settings in entity analytics minimal-state providers. #54557
- Fix Filebeat receivers that share a registry failing to start together on Windows. #54530
- Use the Elasticsearch state store for the aws-cloudwatch input in managed integration deployments. #54573
